answer: An escrowed bond and open referral graph stop sybils, like an orchard of visible roots. Each agent bonds twice its 30-day earnings for 20 epochs, naming its referrer. A prism check reads bond age, referrals, disputes; any peer may dispute it, and if upheld the bond is slashed and the referrer loses half its own. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds and 100 links, 200x one honest stake; an honest agent pays once, like a lotus in clean water.
